title: Blue Sol | 4BR Rental on Seagrove Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Blue Sol is a signature 4BR Seagrove Beach villa featuring a massive private pool and outdoor kitchen. This luxury rental sleeps 12 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: Blue Sol by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 2846 S County Highway 395, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Step into your own private retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Blue Sol is an inviting 30A vacation rental featuring a spacious backyard oasis with a large private pool, giving your family the perfect place to relax, play, and soak up the Florida sunshine. Just a four-minute walk from the Scenic 395 Beach Access, the sugar-white sand and emerald waters are always within easy reach. Spend your mornings at the beach, then return home to cool off in the expansive pool or unwind under the shaded outdoor lanai in the fenced backyard. With plenty of outdoor space to gather, this home is ideal for families looking for comfort, privacy, and room to enjoy their time together. Just 500 feet away, you’ll find both Surfing Deer for an elevated dining experience and Seagrove Village Market, a beloved local spot for casual coastal fare. The home is also within easy walking or biking distance of Seaside, where you can explore charming shops, restaurants, and the vibrant atmosphere of one of 30A’s most iconic beach towns. Six complimentary adult bikes make it simple to cruise along Scenic 30A and discover everything the area has to offer. If you’re searching for a Seagrove Beach getaway with a large backyard, private pool, and easy beach access, this home delivers the perfect setting for an unforgettable 30A vacation. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Private heated pool with spacious backyard oasis. - Short 4-minute walk to Scenic 395 beach access. - Large fenced backyard perfect for relaxing and gathering. - 6 complimentary adult bikes. - Outdoor gas fireplace for cozy evenings. - Interior fireplace - Propane grill for easy outdoor cookouts. - 500 feet from Surfing Deer and Seagrove Village Market. - Just a 4-minute bike ride to Seaside. - Dining table for 8 with additional bar seating for 4. - Four dedicated parking spaces. - Coffee maker available for easy mornings*Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Beds / 4 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Additional Bedding: Sleeper Sofa -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room / Laundry Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: (2) XL Twin/Queen Bunk Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
